4597-eclectic-school-readings-stories-fr.title: A Book For Young People
4597-eclectic-school-readings-stories-fr.creator: Unknown
4597-eclectic-school-readings-stories-fr.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It is ours, with all its magic possibilities of being and doing. Yesterday, with its mistakes, misdeeds, lost opportunities, and failures, is gone forever. With the morrow we are not immediately concerned. It is but a promise yet to be fulfilled. Hidden behind the veil of the future, it may dimly beckon us, but it is yet a shadowy, unsubstantial vision, one that we, perhaps, never may realize.

5655-burke-s-speech-on-conciliation-with.title: Burke S Speech On Conciliation With America
5655-burke-s-speech-on-conciliation-with.creator: Edmond Burke
5655-burke-s-speech-on-conciliation-with.description: A book by Edmond Burke. appointed, called the Lords Commissioners for Trade and Plantations. The royal governors found in this board ready sympathizers, and were not slow to report their grievances, and to insist upon more stringent regulations for enforcing obedience. Some of the retaliative measures employed were the suspension of the writ of habeas corpus, the abridgment of the freedom of the press and the prohibition of elections.

arxiv-1902-02533.title: Ensemble Prediction of Time to Event Outcomes with Competing Risks: A Case Study of Surgical Complications in Crohn’s Disease
arxiv-1902-02533.creator: Michael C Sachs, Andrea Discacciati, Åsa H Everhov, Ola Olén, Erin E Gabriel
arxiv-1902-02533.description: Abstract We develop a novel algorithm to predict the occurrence of major abdominal surgery within 5 years following Crohn’s disease diagnosis using a panel of 29 baseline covariates from the Swedish population registers. We model pseudo-observations based on the Aalen-Johansen estimator of the cause-specific cumulative incidence with an ensemble of modern machine learning approaches.

arxiv-2001-05016.title: Neural Arithmetic Units
arxiv-2001-05016.creator: Andreas Madsen, Alexander Rosenberg Johansen
arxiv-2001-05016.description: Abstract Neural networks can approximate complex functions, but they struggle to perform exact arithmetic operations over real numbers. The lack of inductive bias for arithmetic operations leaves neural networks without the underlying logic necessary to extrapolate on tasks such as addition, subtraction, and multiplication.

arxiv-2102-08152.title: Magnetic phase diagram of rare-earth orthorhombic perovskite oxides
arxiv-2102-08152.creator: Alireza Sasani, Jorge Iñiguez, Eric Bousquet
arxiv-2102-08152.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Alireza Sasani, Jorge Iñiguez, Eric Bousquet. Spin reorientation and magnetisation reversal are two important features of the rare-earth orthorhombic provskites ( R ​ M RM O 3 ’s) that have attracted a lot of attention, though their exact microscopic origin has eluded researchers.

arxiv-2103-14848.title: On the effect of boundary conditions on the scalability of Schwarz methods
arxiv-2103-14848.creator: Gabriele Ciaramella and Luca Mechelli
arxiv-2103-14848.description: Abstract 1 Introduction This work is concerned with convergence and weak scalability 1 1 1 Here, weak scalability is understood in the sense that the contraction factor does not deteriorate as the number N of subdomains increases and, hence, the number of iterations, needed to reach a given tolerance, is uniformly bounded in N ; see, e.g., Ciaramella_mini_10_CiaramellaGander4 .

arxiv-2306-00998.title: Towards Selection of Text-to-speech Data to Augment ASR Training
arxiv-2306-00998.creator: Shuo Liu 1,2 , Leda Sarı 1 , Chunyang Wu 1 , Gil Keren 1 , Yuan Shangguan 1 , Jay Mahadeokar 1 , Ozlem Kalinli 1
arxiv-2306-00998.description: Abstract This paper presents a method for selecting appropriate synthetic speech samples from a given large text-to-speech (TTS) dataset as supplementary training data for an automatic speech recognition (ASR) model. We trained a neural network, which can be optimised using cross-entropy loss or Arcface loss, to measure the similarity of a synthetic data to real speech.

arxiv-2307-03082.title: A two-sample comparison of mean survival times of uncured sub-populations – Part I: Nonparametric analyses
arxiv-2307-03082.creator: Dennis Dobler ∗ label=e2]d.dobler@vu.nl, Eni Musta ∗ label=e1]e.musta@uva.nl, Dennis Dobler ∗ label=e2]d.dobler@vu.nl, Eni Musta ∗ label=e1]e.musta@uva.nl, Dennis Dobler ∗ label=e2]d.dobler@vu.nl, Eni Musta ∗ label=e1]e.musta@uva.nl, Dennis Dobler ∗ label=e2]d.dobler@vu.nl, Eni Musta ∗ label=e1]e.mu
arxiv-2307-03082.description: Abstract Comparing the survival times among two groups is a common problem in time-to-event analysis, for example if one would like to understand whether one medical treatment is superior to another. In the standard survival analysis setting, there has been a lot of discussion on how to quantify such difference and what can be an intuitive, easily interpretable, summary measure.

arxiv-2309-11623.title: Leveraging Negative Signals with Self-Attention for Sequential Music Recommendation DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.8372449 Conference: Music Recommender Systems Workshop at the 17th ACM Recommender Systems Conference (RecSys’23); September 19, 2023; Singapore CCS: Information systems Recommender systems CCS: I
arxiv-2309-11623.creator: Pavan Seshadri, Peter Knees
arxiv-2309-11623.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Pavan Seshadri, Peter Knees. Music streaming services heavily rely on their recommendation engines to continuously provide content to their consumers. Sequential recommendation consequently has seen considerable attention in current literature, where state of the art approaches focus on self-attentive models leveraging contextual information such as long and short-term user history and item features; however, most of these studies focus on long-form content domains (retail, movie, etc.) rather than short-form, such as music. Additionally, many do not explore incorporating negative session-level feedback during training.

arxiv-2411-01684.title: Classification of abelian finite-dimensional C ∗ C^{*} -algebras by orthogonality
arxiv-2411-01684.creator: Bojan Kuzma, Sushil Singla
arxiv-2411-01684.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Bojan Kuzma, Sushil Singla. The main goal of the article is to prove that if 𝒜 1 \mathcal{A}_{1} and 𝒜 2 \mathcal{A}_{2} are Birkhoff-James isomorphic C ∗ C^{*} -algebras over the fields 𝔽 1 \mathbb{F}_{1} and 𝔽 2 \mathbb{F}_{2} , respectively and if 𝒜 1 \mathcal{A}_{1} finite-dimensional, abelian of dimension greater than one, then 𝔽 1 = 𝔽 2 \mathbb{F}_{1}=\mathbb{F}_{2} and 𝒜 1 \mathcal{A}_{1} and 𝒜 2 \mathcal{A}_{2} are (isometrically) ∗ \ast -isomorphic C ∗ C^{*} -algebras.

arxiv-2411-03916.title: Discretizing the Bistability of Mode-Locked Electron Spin Precession: An Overhauser Field Hysteresis Manifestation
arxiv-2411-03916.creator: Estefanio Kesto, Michael J. Dominguez, Vanessa Sih
arxiv-2411-03916.description: Abstract Electron-nuclear spin interactions by pulsed optical pumping have been found to polarize the nuclear spin system, leading to the nuclei building up an intrinsic magnetic field known as the Overhauser field. Studies have indicated an Overhauser field hysteresis effect dependent on the sweep direction of an externally applied magnetic field in negatively detuned periodically pumped Si-doped GaAs.

arxiv-2412-19927.title: Modeling Continuous Spatial-temporal Dynamics of Turbulent Flow with Test-time Refinement
arxiv-2412-19927.creator: Shengyu Chen, Peyman Givi, Can Zheng, Xiaowei Jia
arxiv-2412-19927.description: Abstract The precise simulation of turbulent flows holds immense significance across various scientific and engineering domains, including climate science, freshwater science, and energy-efficient manufacturing. Within the realm of simulating turbulent flows, large eddy simulation (LES) has emerged as a prevalent alternative to direct numerical simulation (DNS), offering computational efficiency.

arxiv-2503-09961.title: Edge-Fog Computing-Enabled EEG Data Compression via Asymmetrical Variational Discrete Cosine Transform Network
arxiv-2503-09961.creator: Xin Zhu, Hongyi Pan, Ahmet Enis Cetin
arxiv-2503-09961.description: Abstract The large volume of electroencephalograph (EEG) data produced by brain-computer interface (BCI) systems presents challenges for rapid transmission over bandwidth-limited channels in Internet of Things (IoT) networks. To address the issue, we propose a novel multi-channel asymmetrical variational discrete cosine transform (DCT) network for EEG data compression within an edge-fog computing framework.

arxiv-2507-15245.title: SPAR: Scholar Paper Retrieval with LLM-based Agents for Enhanced Academic Search
arxiv-2507-15245.creator: Xiaofeng Shi, Yuduo Li, Qian Kou, Longbin Yu, Jinxin Xie, Hua Zhou
arxiv-2507-15245.description: Abstract Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have opened new opportunities for academic literature retrieval. However, existing systems often rely on rigid pipelines and exhibit limited reasoning capabilities. We introduce SPAR , a multi-agent framework that incorporates RefChain-based query decomposition and query evolution to enable more flexible and effective search.

arxiv-2510-08359.title: Doubly Robust Estimation with Stabilized Weights for Binary Proximal Outcomes in Micro-Randomized Trials
arxiv-2510-08359.creator: Jinho Cha, Eunchan Cha
arxiv-2510-08359.description: Abstract Micro-randomized trials (MRTs) are increasingly used to evaluate mobile health interventions with binary proximal outcomes. Standard inverse probability weighting (IPW) estimators are unbiased but unstable in small samples or under extreme randomization. Estimated mean excursion effect (EMEE) improves efficiency but lacks double robustness.

pmc-10572993.title: Estrogens, Estrogen Receptors and Tumor Microenvironment in Ovarian Cancer
pmc-10572993.creator: Marta Justyna Kozieł, Agnieszka Wanda Piastowska-Ciesielska, Carmela Ricciardelli
pmc-10572993.description: Ovarian cancer is one of the most common cancers in women and the most concerning issues in gynecological oncology in recent years. It is postulated that many factors may contribute to the development of ovarian cancer, including hormonal imbalance. Estrogens are a group of hormones that have an important role both in physiological and pathological processes.

pmc-10622544.title: Glycoengineered keratinocyte library reveals essential functions of specific glycans for all stages of HSV-1 infection
pmc-10622544.creator: Ieva Bagdonaite, Irina N Marinova, Asha M Rudjord-Levann, Emil M H Pallesen, Sarah L King-Smith, Richard Karlsson, Troels B Rømer, Yen-Hsi Chen, Rebecca L Miller, Sigvard Olofsson, Rickard Nordén, Tomas Bergström, Sally Dabelsteen, Hans H Wandall
pmc-10622544.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Viral and host glycans represent an understudied aspect of host-pathogen interactions, despite potential implications for treatment of viral infections. This is due to lack of easily accessible tools for analyzing glycan function in a meaningful context. Here we generate a glycoengineered keratinocyte library delineating human glycosylation pathways to uncover roles of specific glycans at different stages of herpes simplex virus type 1 (HSV-1) infectious cycle.

pmc-11352541.title: Effective-Component Compatibility of Bufei Yishen Formula III Suppresses Mitochondrial Oxidative Damage in COPD: Via Pkm2/Nrf2 Pathway
pmc-11352541.creator: Yang Liu, Lanxi Zhang, Jie Zhao, Ruilong Lu, Xuejie Shao, Kexin Xu, Jiansheng Li, Yange Tian
pmc-11352541.description: PurposeThe main objective of this study was to explore the mechanism of effective component compatibility of Bufei Yishen formula III (ECC-BYF III) in inhibiting mitochondrial oxidative stress in a rat model of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).MethodsA549 cells exposed to cigarette smoke extract (CSE) were used to establish a model of mitochondrial oxidative damage.

pmc-12449763.title: Isolated splenic metastasis presenting at diagnosis of HER2-positive de novo metastatic breast cancer: a case report
pmc-12449763.creator: Maika Yoshioka, Masafumi Shimoda, Kaori Abe, Nanae Masunaga, Masami Tsukabe, Tetsuhiro Yoshinami, Yoshiaki Sota, Tomohiro Miyake, Tomonori Tanei, Kenzo Shimazu
pmc-12449763.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Splenic metastasis is uncommon, and truly isolated splenic metastasis (ISM) from breast cancer is a clinical rarity. Contemporary autopsy series reports splenic involvement in <1% of breast cancer-related deaths, and fewer than 15 well-documented ISM cases have been published. We report a 71-year-old woman presenting with a right-breast mass, regional lymphadenopathy, and a solitary splenic lesion detected on staging computed tomography (CT) and positron emission tomography-CT. Biopsy confirmed hormone receptor-negative, HER2-positive invasive ductal carcinoma.

pmc-12465440.title: Principal components-based selection criteria for genetic improvement of growth in sheep breeding programs
pmc-12465440.creator: Ajoy Mandal, Indrajit Gayari, Sylvia Lalhmingmawii, David R. Notter, Hasan Baneh
pmc-12465440.description: BackgroundThe objective of this study was to investigate the use of principal components (PC) as potential selection criteria to improve growth in sheep. The PC were derived from body weights of 2223 Muzaffarnagari lambs at birth, 90, 180, 270 and 360 days of age. Univariate animal models including various combinations of direct and maternal effects were fitted to the PC.

pmc-12534926.title: FT-like genes in Cannabis and hops: sex specific expression and copy-number variation may explain flowering time variation
pmc-12534926.creator: Caroline A. Dowling, Todd P. Michael, Paul F. McCabe, Susanne Schilling, Rainer Melzer
pmc-12534926.description: Cannabis sativa is a fascinating, yet under-researched, species. To facilitate the global expansion of C. sativa cultivation a greater understanding of flowering time control is crucial. The PEBP gene family consists of universal promoters and repressors of flowering, with homologs of FLOWERING LOCUS T (FT) being highly conserved key regulators of flowering.

pmc-12552265.title: “B” symptoms and CBV conditioning negatively impact survival in mantle cell lymphoma patients undergoing autologous stem cell transplantation
pmc-12552265.creator: Karolina Chromik, Agata Wieczorkiewicz-Kabut, Patrycja Zielińska, Anna Koclęga, Sabina Kadłubek, Jakub Kamiński, Grzegorz Helbig
pmc-12552265.description: Introduction: Mantle cell lymphoma (MCL) is an aggressive B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma with limited curative options. Autologous stem cell transplantation (ASCT) is widely used as consolidation in younger, fit patients. This study aimed to evaluate long-term outcomes after ASCT and identify clinical factors influencing survival.

pmc-13213767.title: Prevalence, Genetic Risks, and Cardiovascular Outcomes of Metabolic and Alcohol-Associated Liver Disease in a Longitudinal Multiethnic US Cohort
pmc-13213767.creator: Jie Yao, Xiuqing Guo, Jingyi Tan, Callie Zaborenko, Jerome I Rotter, Naga P Chalasani
pmc-13213767.description: metabolic risk factors and moderate alcohol consumption.1 However, its epidemiology, genetic architecture, and relationship with cardiovascular (CV) risk are not well defined in diverse populations. Here, we investigated the prevalence of Met-ALD compared to MASLD and their relevant contributions to the CV risk in the Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (MESA), a large, longitudinal, multiethnic US cohort.

pmc-13229199.title: Tubulin flux at spastin-induced nanodamage sites regulates microtubule rescue frequency and EB1 lifetimes
pmc-13229199.creator: Ewa Szczesna, Jeffrey O. Spector, Stephanie L. Sarbanes, Jiayi Chen, Agnieszka Szyk, Antonina Roll-Mecak
pmc-13229199.description: SignificanceMicrotubule severing enzymes are critical in diverse cellular processes. Reconstitution experiments revealed that severing enzymes extract tubulin subunits and catalyze repair with fresh tubulin, creating islands formed of tubulin bound to guanosine triphosphate (GTP) along microtubules that regulate their dynamics.

pmc-13632388.creator: Ji-Soo Song
pmc-13632388.description: BackgroundThe Child Oral Health Impact Profile (COHIP-34) is a validated instrument used to assess oral health-related quality of life (OHRQoL) in children and adolescents. However, evidence on its reliability and validity is limited when administered online, particularly among school-aged children.

pmc-13679154.title: Inhibition of the ATR-CHK1 signaling pathway sensitizes MCPyV-positive Merkel cell carcinoma to gemcitabine
pmc-13679154.creator: Evelyn V Proctor, Sherine F Elsawa, Sarah R Walker, Jingwei Cheng
pmc-13679154.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Merkel cell carcinoma (MCC) is the primary cutaneous neuroendocrine carcinoma with a mortality rate higher than that of melanoma and other common skin cancers. In the United States, most cases of MCC are positive for Merkel cell polyomavirus (MCPyV), in which the viral small T antigen (ST) recruits the Tip60-EP400 chromatin remodeling complex to L-Myc, a MYC family protein with oncogenic properties. This complex initiates MYC-dependent transcriptional programs that induce replication stress.
